verdict.rationale: Granola documents user-configurable transcript auto-deletion with a retention-period dropdown (1 day to 1 year), plus manual deletion of notes with permanent removal and restore. Together these give users first-party control over both retention and deletion. Missing for 10: automatic retention policies for notes (auto-deletion covers transcripts only), evidence of account-level or server-side purge guarantees, programmatic deletion via API/MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
